note: P4270 (Pro 25:21) — if your enemy is hungry, give him bread; if thirsty, give him water.

dims.v: enemy-love — feeding the very one who hates you
the returning of good for evil — giving bread and water to a hungry, thirsty enemy, overcoming his hatred with kindness rather than repaying it
the mercy that answers hatred with bread, and is rewarded by God

sane (enemy / one who hates) — 'if your ENEMY is hungry, give him bread to eat'; the astonishing ethic of returning good for evil, feeding the one who hates you (cf Ex 23:4-5; quoted Rom 12:20). Mercy overcomes enmity, and God rewards it (25:22).
